body.zh: 终端可以直接跑；要嵌进产品，就从 Rust、Node.js 或 Python SDK 开始。下面用 Rust 把完整路径走一遍。
body.en: Run the terminal app directly, or embed the Rust, Node.js, or Python SDK. The walkthrough below follows the Rust path.

note.zh: 同一个 Runtime，不同的产品外壳。
note.en: One runtime behind different product surfaces.

title.zh: 把 Agent 绑到一个项目
title.en: Bind the agent to a project

body.zh: Agent 读取 ACL 和共享能力；AgentSession 负责当前 Workspace 与这一段对话。异步 build 会在第一轮开始前准备好相关资源。
body.en: Agent loads ACL and shared capabilities. AgentSession owns the current workspace and conversation, resolving resources before the first turn.

note.zh: Agent 可以复用，Session 与 Workspace 一一对应。
note.en: Reuse the Agent; bind each Session to a workspace.

body.zh: 自动压缩、token 上限和触发阈值属于 Session 配置，不需要藏进界面层。ContextAssembler 与 Memory 会据此准备模型输入。
body.en: Compaction, token limits, and thresholds belong to SessionOptions rather than UI code. ContextAssembler and memory use them when preparing model input.

note.zh: 大结果会变成 Artifact，模型只拿到受控预览。
note.en: Large results become artifacts; the model receives a bounded preview.

body.zh: read 自动放行，write 每次询问，危险的 shell 命令直接拒绝。规则按 deny、allow、ask 的顺序求值。
body.en: Allow reads, ask before writes, and deny a dangerous shell pattern. Rules evaluate in deny, allow, then ask order.

note.zh: 权限、确认、预算与沙箱共用一条执行链。
note.en: Permission, approval, budgets, and sandboxing share one path.

title.zh: 让 Workspace 决定可用工具
title.en: Let the workspace expose its tools

body.zh: Session 只注册当前 Workspace 真正支持、且权限允许的工具。发起 stream 后，模型调用 read、search、shell 或 Git 都会经过同一条受控路径。
body.en: A Session registers only tools the current workspace supports and policy permits. Every read, search, shell, or Git call follows the same governed path.

note.zh: 对象存储后端不支持本地命令时，Bash 与 Git 不会出现。
note.en: If a workspace cannot run local commands, Bash and Git stay hidden.

title.zh: 把过程交给界面，把现场留给下一次
title.en: Stream the run and keep the evidence

body.zh: 界面消费 AgentEvent；配置 SessionStore 后，save 会把会话、运行记录、Artifact、Trace 和验证结果作为同一代快照提交。
body.en: The UI consumes AgentEvent. With a SessionStore configured, save commits the session, runs, artifacts, traces, and verification data as one snapshot generation.

note.zh: 终端、Web 与 SDK 看到的是同一条事件协议。
note.en: Terminal, Web, and SDK clients share the same event protocol.
